newsitem.title: USA: Reno Air says Q2 hurt by engine problems.
newsitem.headline: Reno Air says Q2 hurt by engine problems.

text.p: Reno Air Inc Thursday said its second quarter results will be adversely affected by engine removals and overhauls caused by a parts shortage.
In a statement, the company said despite the problems, it "expects to report strong traffic for the second quarter."
The company did not detail how much of an impact the engine shortage will have on earnings, and a spokeswoman was not immediately available to comment.

Reno Air said it was forced to temporarily ground three airplanes, two of which were returned to service before the end of June 1997. These factors led to an increase in maintenance expense, a decrease in fleet utilization and an increase in overall unit cost.
It expects to have all its aircraft available by mid-July.
